tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal sras kun gyi 'jug ngogs theg chen spyi bye brag la 'jug tshul zab don sgron me bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di gangs ljongs 'dir gdul bya'i sems can spyi'i bsod nams las rgyal dang rgyal sras kyi rnam par sprul pa rgyal btsun blon 'bangs byang sems du mas mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mang po'i zhabs pad brtan cing don yod rnam bzhi'i mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mchod cing phu dud mdzad de gsung gi gsang ba bzung bas lung rtogs bstan pa rin po che dbu brnyes/ srol btod/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa snga dar phyi dar gnyis su bzhed pa'i phyi dar lo chen rnams kyi nang nas 'brog mi/ ba ri/ gnyan/ mal la sogs pa'i bka' srol 'dzin pa 'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po dang / de'i sras rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i sras bar pa gnyis dang sku'i dbon sa skya paṇa chen dang / 'phags pa rin po che ste zhal rnam pa lnga ni bka'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel nus pa'i bdag nyid chen por gyur pa'i bka' srol 'di la sa lugs zhes yongs su grags shing rgya bod mkhas grub gzu bor gnas pa kun gyis bstod bkur bsngags pa mdzad pa'i skor las 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la dngos su gnang ba'i theg chen lam rim tshang ma tshigs bcad sh+lau ka gcig gis ston nus pa zhen pa bzhi bral dang / 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sgom chen springs yig gnyis lhan cig pa'i 'grel pa tshig nyung go bde dgos zhes sa mtha'i spong ba pa zhig nas bskul ba ltar 'dri ba la/ thog mar zhen pa bzhi bral sogs/ sgom pa po de'i rnam dbye shes pa'i phyir/ sgom chen springs yig gi dgongs pa smos na/

rab gsum/ 'bring gsum/ mtha' gsum du dbye ba mdzad 'dug pa las 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis dman 'bring rab tu dbye ba bshad na/ dang po ni/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs khul byas kyang dam pa'i mgon gyis ma bzung bas zhi gnas sogs dang ldan yang gti mug gi dbang du song bas 'phyi ba tshang nyal gyi sgom chen dang / dad pa dang dge la 'dun pa'i sems med kyang gzhan mos pa dang / rang las lhag par 'gran cing 'dod yon don gnyer can ni gcan gzan ri nyal gyi sgom chen dang / man ngag 'dra min sna tshogs kyis gzugs med gdug pa can gyis bstan pa'i mngon shes rdzu 'phrul phan byed ltar snang can gyis 'gro ba rnams rmongs su bcug nas rnyed pa don gnyer can ni wa 'dra grong stong 'grim pa'i sgom chen yin par gsungs pas dman pa gsum po 'di spang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo sngags kyi don mang du mi shes kyang smin byed kyi dbang zhus pa'i bla ma dam pa spyi bo'i gtsug tu dad pas sgom zhing mos gus sogs bcos min yod pa ni thar pa'i lam sna zin pa'i sgom chen dang / lta ba klong du ma gyur yang rang gis smin grol rnam dag thob nas lag len 'khrul med kyis gzhan shi gson la brtse sems phan 'dogs can ni/ gzhan phan yid bzhin nor bu'i sgom chen dang / lam la 'bad pa lhur len rang ma 'grub kyang dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa ni srid pa myur sgrol gyi sgom chen du gsungs pas tshul de dag gang rung la bslab par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mtha' bzhi spros bral lta bar rang gdeng thob cing / bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i ting 'dzin klong du gyur la/ rgyal ba'i bstan dang mi 'gal ba'i spyod pa can ni seng ge gangs la gnas pa'i sgom chen dang / 'gro kun sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i go cha dang ldan zhing / phyag mchod bskor ba sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs dang stong nyid zab mo'i don las mi g.yo bar so so'i gnas lugs shes pa'i rnam dbye can ni dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i sgom chen dang /

lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang ldan zhing bsdu dngos bzhi dang / phyin drug can ni bsdu bas gzhan don sgom chen du gsungs pas 'di 'dra gang rung e 'ong snyam pa'i 'dun pa byed pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin no/ /de ltar lam nyams su len pa'i gang zag gi rigs bshad nas/ blang bya'i lam la tshul shin tu mang yang don gyi snying po sangs rgyas kyi lam po che theg chen mtha' dag dril ba'i man ngag zhen pa bzhi bral 'grel pa'i ston byed nyung ngu ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge'i gsungs las/ dam chos sgrub pa'i lus rten rnyed dka' zhing / /mi rtag myur du 'jig pa'i rang bzhin du/ /legs par rtogs nas dge sdig blang dor la/ /gzob pa lhur len rim pa dang po'o/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor mtha' med 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal chu srin kha ru chud mthong nas/ /myang 'das thar pa'i skam sa don gnyer ba'i/ /nges 'byung bskyed pa rim pa gnyis pa'o/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba bdag gi pha dang ma/ /yang yang byas shing phan gdags drin dran nas/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog gis/ /gzhan don bsgrub pa rim pa gsum pa'o/ /ji ltar snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems/ /sems nyid rgyu rkyen tshogs tsam sgyu ma bzhin/ /sgyu ma spros dang bral bar rtogs gyur nas/ /gnas lugs bsgom pa rim pa bzhi pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba las/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de la tshe 'di blos thong ba la dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dge sdig blang dor shes pa zhig dgos pas de dag la thos bsam gal che/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /zhes pas bstan te/ 'khor ba mtho dma' gang du gnas kyang dngos brgyud sdug bsngal las ma 'das te/ dngos ni dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal rnams yin/

brgyud ni mi lha min lha'i sdug bsngal rnams yin pas de dag la myang 'das bzhis bcug nas thar 'dod kyi blo bcos min bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /zhes pas bstan te/ khams gsum sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du rig nas/ de las rang nyid thar 'dod kyi thabs la 'bad pa ni shin tu 'khrul pa yin te/ mtha' med sems can gyis grangs med pha ma byas pa rnams thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis rgyu sdig pa bsags nas bde ba 'dod kyang 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong ba rnams bor/ rang gcig pu thar 'dod yod na ngo tsha khrel med drin mi shes pa ma rabs tha chad du 'gyur pas rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo spangs nas sems can pha mar shes pa'i byams pa/ de dag sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bdag bde sdug 'dod pa dang / mi 'dod pa mnyam pas/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ gzhan sdug bsngal sel ched du rang nyid kyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bskal mang bzod cing / bdag gis bskal par bsags pa'i bde dge gzhan la ltos med du gtong ba'i bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems/ de'i ched du gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob 'dod smon sems/ de myur du 'grub phyir sbyin pa rnam bzhi/ snyan smra/ don spyod/ don mthun te 'jug sems gzhan smin pa'i thabs/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab ste phyin drug rang smin byed sogs rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtshor bslab dgos pas spyod 'jug sogs la thos bsam byas nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam thar bzang po'i rjes su 'jug pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /zhes pas bstan te/ snang ba 'di kun rang sems thog ma med pa nas dge mi dge dge sdig gnyis ka min pa'i rtog pa sna tshogs kyis bslad pa'i snang ba'i 'char tshul de dang de 'dra byung ba yin pas snang ba sems yin/ sems bag chags kyis bslad pa'i sgyu ma yin/

sgyu ma kun rdzob tu rten 'brel tshogs pa las byung ba yin/ don dam pa de'i ngo bo 'di zhes brjod du med pa ni blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'o/ /de dag kyang rim bzhin blo chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du slong ba/ lam 'khrul pa zhi ba/ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ba zhes pa'i nyams len no/ /de nyid theg pa thun mong min pa sngags kyi nyams len dang bstun na bskyed rdzogs zab khyad can du ma bzhugs mod/ 'dir re zhig grub chen gnyan tshem bu lugs kyi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi smar khrid ltar na/ gang khrid/ gang nas khrid/ gang du khrid dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan du khrid do/ /de las gnyis pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po la bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ bsgom khang dben par rgyun mchod bzhugs drung / bsam gtan stan la/ de'i spyod lam gyis 'dug ste skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen khri dar sna tshogs kyi gdan pad zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngam 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can la rang gis thob pa'i smar khrid brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du yi dam lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas longs sprul/ rgyab tu chos po ti/ g.yon du dge 'dun longs sprul/ mtha' skor du chos srung bzhugs par mos/ skyabs 'gro byed po rang dang dgra 'dre pha ma rigs drug srid pa bar do'i sems can kun/ rgyu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa/ rang don yid byed kyi 'jigs pa/ tha ma snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa ste gsum dang / skyabs yul gyi yon tan mthong bas dang ba'i dad pa/ de thob 'dod kyi dad pa/ de la brten nas byin rlabs 'byung ba'i yid ches kyi dad pa dang sems can la bcos min snying rjes kun nas bslang / dus spang gnyen ro gcig byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/

bla ma la 'dren pa/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun dang chos srung la zla grogs zhu ba'i bsam pas rang gzhan thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa chig sgril gyis skyabs 'gro byed par bsams la ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub bar/ /bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang / /chos srung kun la skyabs su mchi/ /mkhyen brtse nus byin myur tu stsol/ /zhes nyer gcig sogs brjod/ skyabs kun phyag 'tshal skyabs byin rlabs/ /bar chad kun srungs chos min spongs/ /byams snying byang sems zhi lhag gi /ting 'dzin yang dag don rtogs shog /lan cig de dag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sku gnyis mngon du gyur nas sems can kun rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/ skyabs yul 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ 'khor bar sems can sdug bsngal can kun drin can pha mar shes shing / drin lan du sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i lam nyams su blang snyam pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lam nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan zhing / rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyi bo'i yab yum la thim/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon sbyang du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems mchod/ thugs rje byin rlabs 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun sbyor mtshams nas byung ba spyi bo nas zhugs bdag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dud khu rnag khrag srog chags kyi rnam pas thon shul thams cad bdud rtsi khengs/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga bān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur/ gsum pa ni/ skyabs yul sngar bzhin gsal btab la maṇ+ḍal ci 'grub 'bul/ bzhi pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor rin po che'i khri dang pad nyi la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol zhing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis khrom tshogs su bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas skyabs gnas thams cad spyan drangs bla ma rnams la thim par gyur/

grub gnyis char 'bebs bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas spang gnyen ro gcig tu gyur/ sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las dang po ni/ rang gi snying sgo stong pa lta bu gzhi stong nyid las byang chub pa'i nang paṃ pad a zla'i gdan ni gdan pad zla las byang chub pa'i steng hrīḥdakar ring cha tsheg drag can ni gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa de'i 'od kyis sdig sgrib dang lus gdos bcas sbyangs 'od phung du gyur pa ni gong bu las byang chub pa/ de las pad dkar 'dab brgyad ge sar can ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ de las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig spyan gnyis/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo/ g.yas 'og ma shel phreng / g.yon 'og ma pad dkar/ ral pa'i thor cog zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung / dar dkar stod g.yogs/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs rin po che'i rgyan can snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba ni sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa'i thugs kar zla ba gnas pa'i hrīḥ'adi 'od kyis snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ yang 'od 'phros pas yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs nas thim/ yang 'od 'phros pas 'og min nas rtsa ba'i bla ma byon nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor pad+ma dar gdan la 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas dbur brgyan/ de la mdo rgyud man ngag rigs kyi bla brgyud thams cad thim/ res 'ga' gang mos pa'i bla ma de 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can la bla ma thams cad thim/ rang gi snying gar pad zla la hrīḥdakar por/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sngags phreng des bskor/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ de gsal bar gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ sgra grag stong la sems gtad/ rang yi dam kun 'dus/

spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus/ sems can thams cad spyan ras gzigs su gsal bas sngags gsung bar gyur/ zhes dmigs pa de dang ma bral bar sngags bzla'o/ /brtan pa thob nas krong bskyed byed pa ste snod bcud dag pa snang ba sku'i khyer so longs sku lam byed/ grag pa sngags su shar ba grag stong gsung gi khyer so sprul sku lam byed/ dran rtog ye shes su shar ba rig stong thugs kyi khyer so/ chos sku lam byed de de gsum dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ lus ma bcos pa rnam snang chos bdun ldan/ ngag ma bcos pa rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud pa/ sems ma bcos pa dus gsum gyi rnam rtog la 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyod/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da lta'i shes pa rang so gsal le sing nge ye re rjen ner bzhag pa sogs khrid gzhung bzhin gegs sel bogs 'don can du bsgoms pas lam rtags rnams 'byung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ thun zhabs su/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs bsngo smon bkra shis kyi tshig brjod/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor drug las/ dang po zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung bzang ngan gang byed kyi tshe yi dam kun 'dus bla ma kun 'dus dran pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad/ gnyis pa gos bzang ngan gang gyon yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas gyon pas mchod/ gsum pa nyal ba oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs/ bzhi pa gnyid 'od gsal ni snying pad zla la spyan ras gzigs theb rdog tsam pa bsam pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis spyi bo'i bla ma snying dbus su spyan drangs/ de'i spyi bor bzhugs pa la sems gtad nas log lnga pa dang drug pa ni khrid yig bzhin te/ de ltar byas pas rang gzhan gyis don myur du 'grub par 'gyur zhing / bsnyen pa sbyin sreg gi yi ge kho bos logs su byas pa ltar nyams su len par spro na de bzhin bya'o//
